entries.summary: Implemented per-user GitHub video segmentation with per-course repos. Each course gets its own repo: aura-course-{slug}. Each lesson is a folder. Default segment duration changed from 5min to 1min.
entries.details: New model: GitHubAccount (user, github_username, github_token). Removed repo_name field. API: GET/POST/DELETE /courses/github/ + GET /courses/{id}/github/. Video upload uses user's GitHub token with per-course repos. Default segment_duration=60 seconds. User can override via API (30-3600 seconds).
entries.code:
POST /api/courses/github/ {github_username, github_token}
DELETE /api/courses/github/
GET /api/courses/{id}/github/ - returns repo_url, lessons, segments
POST /api/courses/video-upload/ {file, lesson_id, segment_duration}

# segment_duration default changed:
# - video_services.py: split_video(segment_duration=60)
# - video_services.py: process_video_upload(segment_duration=60)
# - serializers.py: default=60
decisions: Each course gets its own repo: aura-course-{course-slug}
Each lesson is a folder: lesson-{id}-{title}
User can override segment_duration via API (30-3600 seconds)
